title: OpenHuman
summary: An open source AI harness built with the human in mind
content: An open source AI harness built with the human in mind | OpenHuman | Product Hunt Launching today OpenHuman Launching today An open source AI harness built with the human in mind 1.3K followers An open source AI harness built with the human in mind 1.3K followers Visit website OpenClaw 90% of people who try AI agents give up. Three reasons: memory that resets every session, your data sitting in someone else's cloud and a terminal just to get started. Real blockers. OpenHuman fixes all of it. Local-first, privacy-first. It remembers everything about you and actually gets smarter the more you use it. Every feature lives in one simple interface. Fully open source. One-click setup. P.S. The product is in beta, so expect bugs, but we're building and shipping fast. OpenHuman Maker 📌 Heya! I'm Steven, founder of TinyHumans. A few months ago I tried to set up an open-source AI agent for my dad. Three hours later and after wrestling with API keys, YAML and a terminal he had never opened in his life, we both gave up. That's when I realised that every powerful AI agent today is built for the 0.01% who can spin up their own runtime. The other 99.99% are watching the agent revolution from the sidelines. So we built OpenHuman. OpenHuman is a super-intelligent AI agent that anyone can use. Two-minute setup. No config files. A simple GUI you'd hand to your parents and they'd actually figure out. Connect Gmail, Slack, Telegram, Notion, and GitHub in one click and it just works. A few things I'm proud of: * It runs locally. Encrypted vault. We never sell your data. * It never forgets. Real memory across sessions, not session-only. * It's open-source under GNU. * It's free to start: no engineer, no GPU, no $6k setup bill. content: Predicts your TSA wait before you leave for the airport. | Atlas Navigation | Product Hunt Launching today Atlas Navigation Launching today Predicts your TSA wait before you leave for the airport. 62 followers Predicts your TSA wait before you leave for the airport. 62 followers Visit website Travel apps • Predictive AI • Analytics Databases Predict TSA security wait times before you get to the airport. Every other tool shows you what the line looks like right now. Atlas tells you what it'll look like when you arrive. Our machine learning model is trained on millions of real wait time data points across 100+ US airports. After you clear security, report your wait in two taps. Every report makes predictions sharper for everyone. Completely free. No paywall. Know Before You Go. Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment TJ Clayton Atlas Navigation Maker 📌 You're standing at the TSA entrance and the line wraps around the corner. Except you checked 20 minutes ago and it said 5 minutes. That estimate was a snapshot of the past, not a prediction of what you'd actually walk into. That's why I built Atlas. It doesn't just show you the current line. It predicts what TSA will look like when you arrive, using a machine learning model trained on millions of real wait time data points across 100+ US airports. After you go through security, Atlas asks you to report your actual wait in two taps. Every report makes the next prediction sharper for everyone. I'm a law student who flies out of Austin regularly and got tired of guessing. So I built the thing I wished existed. Atlas is completely free. No paywall. I'd rather have 10,000 travelers making predictions better than 100 paying for a worse product. Try it before your next flight: atlas-navigation.com. Tell me if the prediction was right — that's the only feedback that matters.
